headline: No budget moves this week: no channel shows a sustained efficiency drop, and LinkedIn, the weakest channel, is above the 1.5 ROAS target under 4 of 5 attribution models, so it gets a test instead of a cut.

tests.hypothesis: LinkedIn is at or above the 1.5 ROAS target (implied 1.77 to 2.37 under four of five models) but below it on last-touch (1.33). A holdout will show whether it earns the target.
tests.design: Geo holdout: pause LinkedIn in about 20% of matched regions for 4 weeks. Measure total conversions and revenue, including direct, Google branded and email-assisted, in held-out vs exposed regions. Also add a "LinkedIn" option to the self-reported survey. Decision rule: if incremental ROAS is below 1.5, cut 30%.

tests.hypothesis: Direct conversions are rising slightly (0.5 to 0.7/day) and AI-assistant answers are rising (2% to 5%). The source may be untracked AI referrals, but the counts are too small to say.
tests.design: No spend holdout is possible. Tag AI-referrer traffic (chatgpt.com, perplexity and similar referrers) and split the "AI assistant" and "ChatGPT" survey answers into one tracked bucket. Re-check in 4 weeks. Needs at least 30 direct conversions per week before acting.

flag_verdicts.reason: The Sep 12-18 Google spend spike (1.77x median) was planned-looking and CPA held at $26.37 vs $22.67 before. Weekly spend returned to about $4.1k by Sep 21. Google's last-week CPA is $20.84 vs a $24.07 prior average.

Direct rose from 0.5 to 0.7 conversions a day, but that is 3-8 conversions a week, and direct is only 1.4% of attributed credit. Last week had 3. AI-assistant answers rose from 2% to 5% of roughly 100 responses a week, about 5 people. This is too small to act on. I recommended tagging AI referrers and will re-check.

flags.message: google_search spend jumped for 7 days (2026-09-12 to 2026-09-18); CPA held at $26 vs $23. Likely fine, confirm before acting.
Direct conversions grew 1.5x (0.5 to 0.7/day) while paid spend moved 1.00x. Self-reported AI answers went from 2% to 5%. Something untracked is driving buyers.
